details.name: Black Ops
details.text: When you receive this card, if you are not the Firmament: The Firmament player may place 1 facedown plot card in their play area with your control token on it. Then, gain 2 command tokens, gain 2 trade goods, and purge this card.

details.name: Ancient Burial Sites
details.window: At the start of the agenda phase
details.text: Choose 1 player. Exhaust each cultural planet owned by that player.
details.flavorText: The images depicted a race that Rin had never seen before. Curious. Could it be that this was a race that was exterminated by the Lazax?

details.name: Assassinate Representative
details.window: After an agenda is revealed
details.text: Choose 1 player. That player cannot vote on this agenda.
details.flavorText: With a sickening crunch of bone and metal, unit.desgn.FLAYESH extracted its stinger from the blood-drenched skull of the Jol-Nar councilor.

details.name: Bribery
details.window: After the speaker votes on an agenda
details.text: Spend any number of trade goods. For each trade good spent, cast 1 additional vote for the outcome on which you voted.
details.notes: This card is useless if argent is speaker or if representative government is in place.
details.flavorText: We think that this initiative would spell disaster for the galaxy, not just the Creuss. Taivra said, quietly slipping Z'eu an envelope. "Don't you agree?"

details.name: Bunker
details.window: At the start of an invasion
details.text: During this invasion, apply -4 to the result of each BOMBARDMENT roll against planets you control.
details.flavorText: Elder Junn crossed his arms and steadied his breathing. The bombs could not reach them, not this far down. At least, that is what the soldiers had told him.

details.name: Confusing Legal Text
details.window: When you are elected as the outcome of an agenda
details.text: Choose 1 player. That player is the elected player instead.
details.flavorText: Somehow, even after the Council had adjourned, none of them were any closer to understanding the strange and confusing events of the day.

details.name: Construction Rider
details.window: After an agenda is revealed
details.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, place 1 space dock from your reinforcements on a planet you control.
details.flavorText: The vote was nearly unanimous. The council would provide funding for the restoration. Ciel was furious.

details.name: Courageous to the End
details.window: After 1 of your ships is destroyed during a space combat
details.text: Roll 2 dice. For each result equal to or greater than that ship's combat value, your opponent must choose and destroy 1 of their ships.
details.flavorText: Coughing up blood and covered in burns, Havvat collapsed against the rapidly overheating ship core. She smiled. She would be remembered.

details.name: Cripple Defenses
details.window: Action
details.text: Choose 1 planet. Destroy each PDS on that planet.
details.notes: This may be played on a planet with zero PDS.
details.flavorText: Titanic vines burst forth from the ground, wrapping themselves around the system's primary firing cylinder, breaking it free from its moorings, and bringing it crashing down upon the installation below.

details.name: Diplomacy Rider
details.window: After an agenda is revealed
details.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, choose 1 system that contains a planet you control. Each other player places a command token from their reinforcements in that system.
details.flavorText: Ciel evaluated the other senators. Weak, all of them. This was his game to win.

details.name: Direct Hit
details.window: After another player's ship uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE to cancel a hit produced by your units or abilities
details.text: Destroy that ship.
details.flavorText: There it was! An opening! Neekuaq gestured wildly, a rare display for one normally quite reserved. "Fire the main battery!"
details.wildWildWindow: After another player's ship or mech uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE to cancel a hit produced by your units or abilities
details.wildWildText: Destroy that unit.

details.window: After another player's ship uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE to cancel a hit produced by your units or abilities
details.text: Destroy that ship.
details.flavorText: The Loncara Ssodu's main battery flared to life, firing a volley directly into the flickering starboard shield of the Letnev dreadnought.
details.wildWildWindow: After another player's ship or mech uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE to cancel a hit produced by your units or abilities
details.wildWildText: Destroy that unit.

details.text: Destroy that ship.
details.flavorText: For a moment, it looked as if the dreadnought's shield would hold, but a moment later, the ship began to come apart where the attack had pierced its hull.
details.wildWildWindow: After another player's ship or mech uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE to cancel a hit produced by your units or abilities
details.wildWildText: Destroy that unit.

details.text: Destroy that ship.
details.flavorText: Neekuaq watched, satisfied, as the ship was wracked by a series of explosions from within, huge armored plates and other debris hurtling off into the darkness.
details.wildWildWindow: After another player's ship or mech uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE to cancel a hit produced by your units or abilities
details.wildWildText: Destroy that unit.

details.name: Disable
details.window: At the start of an invasion in a system that contains 1 or more of your opponents' PDS units
details.text: Your opponents' PDS units lose PLANETARY SHIELD and SPACE CANNON during this invasion.
details.flavorText: Ssruu has met their systems and fixed them. Ssruu dropped a handful of ripped wires and broken circuitry on the pedestal before Q'uesh Sish. "He will await his next task aboard his ship."

details.name: Distinguished Councilor
details.window: After you cast votes on an outcome of an agenda
details.notes: This card is useless if representative government is in place.
details.text: Cast 5 additional votes for that outcome.
details.flavorText: Elder Junn was a wonder to behold. He knew the name of every senator, made small talk effortlessly, and commanded attention when he spoke. Magmus hated everything about him.

details.name: Economic Initiative
details.window: Action
details.text: Ready each cultural planet you control.
details.notes: This may be played by a player that controls zero cultural planets.
details.flavorText: Large sum of Hacan currency flowed freely into the project, and somehow, defying all logic, the returns were even greater.

details.name: Emergency Repairs
details.window: At the start or end of a combat round
details.text: Repair all of your units that have SUSTAIN DAMAGE in the active system.
details.flavorText: What do you mean 'It's fine!?' Dahla said, nearly tripping over a damaged bulkhead as the ship rocked from the explosive barrage.

details.name: Experimental Battlestation
details.window: After the active player moves ships into the active system during a tactical action
details.text: Choose 1 of your space docks that is either in or adjacent to that system. That space dock uses SPACE CANNON 5(x3) against the active player's ships in the active system.
details.notes: This resolves in the same window as normal SPACE CANNON fire, and any existing SPACE CANNON abilities will be rolled at the same time. This cannot be used against yourself.
details.flavorText: Arm the relay! Mendosa bared his fangs. "The Saar will not submit!"

details.name: Fighter Prototype
details.window: At the start of the first round of a space combat
details.text: Apply +2 to the result of each of your fighters' combat rolls during this combat round.
details.flavorText: Suffi vaulted excitedly off the prototype's sleek, azure wing, landing effortlessly in its cockpit. "Let's see those damn snakes keep up with us now!"

details.name: Fire Team
details.window: After your ground forces make combat rolls during a round of ground combat
details.text: Reroll any number of your dice.
details.flavorText: Grinning, Jael spun towards the familiar noise of heavy boots hitting the ground. Backup had arrived.

details.window: After you activate a system
details.text: Apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships during this tactical action.
details.flavorText: Mendosa smirked. "Don't ye fret now, girl. It sounds like ye've got somewhere ta be in a hurry, and it just se happens that I ken get ye there right quick."

details.wildWildText: Apply +2 to the move value of each of your ships during this tactical action.

details.wildWildWindow: After you activate a system

details.wildWildWindow: After you activate a system
details.wildWildText: Apply +2 to the move value of each of your ships during this tactical action.

details.name: Focused Research
details.window: Action
details.text: Spend 4 trade goods to research 1 technology
details.flavorText: Stunned, Rin looked over the data, scarcely able to believe what he was seeing. It was nothing short of a major breakthrough. The Headmaster would be pleased.

details.name: Frontline Deployment
details.window: Action
details.text: Place 3 infantry from your reinforcements on 1 planet you control.
details.flavorText: The soldiers poured fire on the writhing mass, but as each tendril vaporized, two more took its place. Panic wormed into the troopers' minds; was the creature growing?

details.name: Ghost Ship
details.window: Action
details.text: Place 1 destroyer from your reinforcements in a non-home system that contains a wormhole and does not contain other players' ships.
details.flavorText: Reports of Creuss vessels sighted in the area had surely been exaggerated. After all, the Creuss had no business this far from the Shaleri passage, and usually kept to themselves.

details.name: Imperial Rider
details.window: After an agenda is revealed
details.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 1 victory point.
details.flavorText: In a sweeping victory that surprised absolutely no one, the Winnu representative singlehandedly elected himself to oversee the analysis of a recently uncovered Lazax data cache.

details.name: In The Silence Of Space
details.window: After you activate a system
details.text: Choose 1 system. During this tactical action, your ships in the chosen system can move through systems that contain other players' ships.
details.flavorText: The Barony ships seemed to defy reality, bending light around them at impossible angles - naught but inky-black contours could be seen.

details.name: Industrial Initiative
details.window: Action
details.text: Gain 1 trade good for each industrial planet you control.
details.notes: This may be played by a player that controls zero industrial planets.
details.flavorText: The Gashlai reactors proved to be extremely effective. With the conversion rate practically doubled, the factories' output was immense.

details.name: Infiltrate
details.window: When you gain control of a planet
details.text: Replace each PDS and space dock that is on that planet with a matching unit from your reinforcements.
details.flavorText: The 1X had scarcely interfaced with the mainframe before it belonged to them completely.

details.name: Insubordination
details.window: Action
details.text: Remove 1 token from another player's tactic pool and return it to their reinforcements.
details.flavorText: Kilik had never been particularly good at following orders. It only seemed natural to get paid for exercising that trait, as long as she didn't think to hard about where the money was coming from.

details.name: Intercept
details.window: After your opponent declares a retreat during a space combat
details.text: Your opponent cannot retreat during this round of space combat.
details.flavorText: The space before the fleeing ship shimmered and warped, revealing the bow of the Y'sia Yssrila bearing down on its position. There would be no escape today.

details.name: Leadership Rider
details.window: After an agenda is revealed
details.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 3 command tokens.
details.flavorText: Rev's impassioned speech stunned the other councilors. Perhaps there was more to these humans than they had initially thought.

details.name: Lost Star Chart
details.window: After you activate a system
details.text: During this tactical action, systems that contain alpha and beta wormholes are adjacent to each other.
details.flavorText: The ship's sensors showed that the ancient star-map had somehow led them beyond the Mahact plateau.

details.name: Lucky Shot
details.window: Action
details.text: Destroy 1 dreadnought, cruiser, or destroyer in a system that contains a planet you control.
details.notes: This cannot be played if there is not a valid target. A player cannot target their own ships.
details.flavorText: The missile - an insignificant spark against the darkness - struck the hull of the dreadnought. Moments later, the starboard flank erupted in flames.

details.name: Maneuvering Jets
details.window: Before you assign hits produced by another player's SPACE CANNON roll
details.text: Cancel 1 hit.
details.flavorText: Something was wrong. T'esla sensed a flicker of movement on the planet's surface, followed by a faint glint of light. Reflexively, she veered her fighter to the side - an action that saved her life.
details.wildWildWindow: Before you assign hits produced by another player's SPACE CANNON roll
details.wildWildText: Cancel ALL hits.

details.wildWildText: Cancel ALL hits.

details.wildWildText: Cancel ALL hits.

details.wildWildWindow: Before you assign hits produced by another player's SPACE CANNON roll

details.name: Mining Initiative
details.window: Action
details.text: Gain trade goods equal to the resource value of 1 planet you control.
details.flavorText: To support its voracious war machine, the N'orr empire cracked the planet's crust and began mining its very core.

details.name: Morale Boost
details.window: At the start of a combat round
details.text: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat round.
details.flavorText: Harrugh stood before his warriors, searching for the words that would express the pride that swelled within him.
details.wildWildWindow: At the start of a combat round
details.wildWildText: Apply +2 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat round.

details.name: Morale Boost
details.window: At the start of a combat round
details.text: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat round.
details.flavorText: We have done the impossible. I am proud to call you my brothers. My equals. My betters. Harrugh's whiskers bristled with energy as he spoke.
details.wildWildWindow: At the start of a combat round
details.wildWildText: Apply +2 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat round.

details.name: Morale Boost
details.window: At the start of a combat round
details.text: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat round.
details.flavorText: Today we turn these invaders to ash and take back what is ours! Harrugh paused, noting the murmurs of approval rippling through the ranks.
details.wildWildWindow: At the start of a combat round
details.wildWildText: Apply +2 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat round.

details.name: Morale Boost
details.window: At the start of a combat round
details.text: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat round.
details.flavorText: The whispering gradually died down and his warriors watched Harrugh expectantly. Every muscle in his body tensed, and he thrust his gyro-spear skyward. "For Kenara!"
details.wildWildWindow: At the start of a combat round
details.wildWildText: Apply +2 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat round.

details.name: Parley
details.window: After another player commits units to land on a planet you control
details.text: Return the committed units to the space area.
details.flavorText: The human admiral returned to his ship, struggling to remember precisely how his meeting with the Collective had gone.

details.name: Plague
details.window: Action
details.text: Choose 1 planet that is controlled by another player. Roll 1 die for each infantry on that planet. For each result of 6 or greater, destroy 1 of those units.
details.notes: This may be played to target a planet with zero infantry. This cannot target a planet owned by the neutral player, as they are not a real player.
details.flavorText: The letani dipped a mossy limb beneath the surface of the reservoir, feeling the flow of the particles within, shifting them, changing them into something different. Something dangerous.

details.name: Political Stability
details.window: When you would return your strategy card(s) during the status phase
details.text: Do not return your strategy card(s). You do not choose strategy cards during the next strategy phase.
details.flavorText: The Winnu councilor breathed a sigh of relief. This opportunity would not be wasted. The peace of the Lazax was within grasp.

details.name: Politics Rider
details.window: After an agenda is revealed
details.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, draw 3 action cards and gain the speaker token.
details.flavorText: The Dirzuga had managed to negotiate themselves into a position of power amongst the other councilors, all of whom still looked terribly uncomfortable in their presence.

details.name: Public Disgrace
details.window: When another player chooses a strategy card during the strategy phase
details.text: That player must choose a different strategy card instead, if able.
details.flavorText: In the months that followed the report, the Council was quick to censure the Jol-Nar for their unethical practices.

details.name: Reactor Meltdown
details.window: Action
details.text: Destroy 1 space dock in a non-home system.
details.notes: As with most action cards, you cannot target your own units for destruction with this action card.
details.flavorText: Flames engulfed the shipyard, a vortex of fire and shrapnel that left nothing untouched.

details.name: Reparations
details.window: After another player gains control of a planet you control
details.text: Exhaust 1 planet that player controls and ready 1 planet you control.
details.notes: This may be played even if all the opponent's planets are exhausted. If any are unexhausted, one must be exhausted though.
details.flavorText: Gila oversaw the reconstruction of the Hacan outpost, but neglected to inform the N'orr representative that the damage was not nearly as severe as he was led to believe.

details.name: Repeal Law

details.text: Discard 1 law from play.
details.flavorText: Eventually, the N'orr diplomat came to an agreement with Hacan Garrus, and the embargo was repealed. Still, he couldn't shake the feeling that Garrus had gotten the better end of the deal.

details.name: Rise of a Messiah

details.text: Place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on each planet you control.
details.flavorText: Harrugh stood atop the dunes, looking down at the thousands of Hacan warriors mustered below. Gathering his strength, he let loose a mighty roar, the will of his people throughout the galaxy echoing forth from within.

details.name: Sabotage

details.text: Cancel that action card.
details.flavorText: Q'uesh Sish tapped her claws impatiently. "You were sssaying?" But the confused Jol-Nar envoy stood silent. It was as if the words had escaped his thoughts entirely.
details.wildWildWindow: When another player plays an action card other than 'Sabotage'

details.text: Cancel that action card.
details.flavorText: unit.desgn.BEELZEBUL followed the group of men through the winding hallways until they stopped at an intersection. Investigators would later find its cracked oculus at the center of a smoking crater, singed, but still functional.

details.wildWildText: Cancel that action card, and then take that card into your hand.

details.name: Sabotage
details.window: When another player plays an action card other than 'Sabotage'
details.text: Cancel that action card.
details.flavorText: Unlenn smashed a clenched fist into the bulkhead, green eyes ablaze with rage. The entire plan had been turned on its head. Such incompetence was unfathomable.
details.wildWildWindow: When another player plays an action card other than 'Sabotage'
details.wildWildText: Cancel that action card, and then take that card into your hand.

details.name: Salvage
details.window: After you win a space combat
details.text: Your opponent gives you all of their commodities.
details.flavorText: When the Coalition raiders had finally returned to their ships, scarcely a bolt remained to salvage from the destroyed vessel.

details.name: Shields Holding
details.window: Before you assign hits to your ships during a space combat
details.text: Cancel up to 2 hits.
details.flavorText: T'ro stared unflinching at the incoming barrage through the bridge's observation deck. The shield would hold.

details.wildWildText: Cancel up to 2 hits.

details.flavorText: The blast from the enemy's main cannon slammed into the space in front of the warship, splitting into two streams across the bow.

details.wildWildText: Cancel up to 2 hits.

details.wildWildText: Cancel up to 2 hits.

details.name: Shields Holding

details.flavorText: As the assault died down and it became clear that the ship sustained no major damage, T'ro clicked his mandibles in anticipation. "Return fire!"
details.wildWildWindow: Before you assign hits to your unit during a combat (space or ground)
details.wildWildText: Cancel up to 2 hits.

details.name: Signal Jamming
details.window: Action
details.text: Choose 1 non-home system that contains or is adjacent to 1 of your ships. Place a command token from another player's reinforcements in that system.
details.flavorText: Meian was practically aglow, wisps of her ether crackling with delight. It was amazing what could be achieved with a well-timed electromagnetic discharge.

details.name: Skilled Retreat
details.window: At the start of a combat round
details.notes: This may only be played during space combat
details.text: Move all of your ships from the active system into an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. The space combat ends in a draw. Then, place a command token from your reinforcements in that system.
details.flavorText: In an instant, the Sol fleet vanished from the Barony's scanners.
details.wildWildWindow: At the start of a combat round
details.wildWildText: Move all of your ships from the active system into an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. The space combat ends in a draw. Do not place a command token from your reinforcements in that system.

details.name: Skilled Retreat

details.notes: This may only be played during space combat
details.text: Move all of your ships from the active system into an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. The space combat ends in a draw. Then, place a command token from your reinforcements in that system.
details.flavorText: The Creuss fleet was gone. No trace remained of their passage.
details.wildWildWindow: At the start of a combat round
details.wildWildText: Move all of your ships from the active system into an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. The space combat ends in a draw. Do not place a command token from your reinforcements in that system.

details.flavorText: T'ro gave the order, and the entire fleet withdrew without question.
details.wildWildWindow: At the start of a combat round

details.flavorText: We have no choice, captain. Ciel looked nervous."We must retreat."
details.wildWildWindow: At the start of a combat round
details.wildWildText: Move all of your ships from the active system into an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. The space combat ends in a draw. Do not place a command token from your reinforcements in that system.

details.name: Spy
details.window: Action
details.text: Choose 1 player. That player gives you 1 random action card from their hand.
details.flavorText: "I'm no spy", Connor said, casually stuffing the data drives into his pack. "Now, how can I get out of here without being seen?"

details.name: Summit
details.window: At the start of the strategy phase
details.text: Gain 2 command tokens.
details.flavorText: At the end of the twelfth day, Rev returned home from the summit in New Moscow feeling physically exhausted and mentally drained. But she was also satisfied. They had a plan - finally - and it was a good plan.

details.name: Tactical Bombardment
details.window: Action
details.text: Choose 1 system that contains 1 or more of your units that have BOMBARDMENT. Exhaust each planet controlled by other players in that system.
details.notes: This may target a system that does not contain any planets controlled by another player, including empty systems or a system containing only your planets. It will have no effect in such a case besides to stall.
details.flavorText: A6's red eyes flickered with activity, and a string of numbers flashed briefly across the screen before he spoke. "Bombardment complete. All enemy installations have been neutralized."

details.name: Technology Rider
details.window: After an agenda is revealed
details.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, research 1 technology.
details.flavorText: The Council granted the Yin funding to research an effective countermeasure to combat the virus. After all, keeping the Yin occupied with the virus meant killing two birds with one stone.

details.name: Trade Rider
details.window: After an agenda is revealed
details.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 5 trade goods.
details.flavorText: The Letnev councilor begrudgingly accepted the N'orr's core mining contract, if only so that the "gracious" Hacan senator didn't secure yet another source of income for his clan.

details.name: Unexpected Action
details.window: Action
details.text: Remove 1 of your command tokens from the game board and return it to your reinforcements.
details.flavorText: M'aban's voice was barely a whisper, cracking as hundreds of flashing lights appeared on her scanner. "We've been tricked."

details.name: Unstable Planet
details.window: Action
details.text: Choose 1 hazardous planet. Exhaust that planet and destroy up to 3 infantry on it.
details.notes: This may be used on an exhausted planet and still kill the infantry. It may also be used on a planet containing no infantry. No targeting your own planet though.
details.flavorText: Another quake shook the planet, and a wave of dirt and rock rose up to swallow the Tekklar legion.

details.name: Upgrade
details.window: After you activate a system that contains 1 or more of your ships
details.text: Replace 1 of your cruisers in that system with 1 dreadnought from your reinforcements.
details.flavorText: More guns? Connor shook his head. "Not more guns. Let's try something bigger."

details.name: Uprising
details.window: Action
details.text: Exhaust 1 non-home planet controlled by another player. Then gain trade goods equal to its resource value.
details.notes: This cannot be used to target an exhausted planet.  Async is ruling you can target the triad with this.
details.flavorText: Harrugh leapt down from the ledge, gyro-spear blazing in the sunlight. In front, the L1Z1X began to take notice. Behind his warriors stood at the ready. Win or lose, this would be the end.

details.name: Veto
details.window: When an agenda is revealed
details.text: Discard that agenda and reveal 1 agenda from the top of the deck. Players vote on this agenda instead.
details.flavorText: Magmus batted the now charred corpse aside with the back of his golden gauntlet. "The Muuat reject your proposal."

details.name: Veto
details.window: When an agenda is revealed
details.text: Discard that agenda and reveal 1 agenda from the top of the deck. Players vote on this agenda instead.
details.flavorText: Magmus batted the now charred corpse aside with the back of his golden gauntlet. "The Muuat reject your proposal."

details.name: Veto
details.window: When an agenda is revealed
details.text: Discard that agenda and reveal 1 agenda from the top of the deck. Players vote on this agenda instead.
details.flavorText: Magmus batted the now charred corpse aside with the back of his golden gauntlet. "The Muuat reject your proposal."

details.name: War Effort
details.window: Action
details.text: Place 1 cruiser from your reinforcements in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.
details.flavorText: The N'orr may not be the most proficient shipwrights, but the willingness of their citizens to do their part far exceeds that of the other great races.

details.name: Warfare Rider
details.window: After an agenda is revealed
details.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, place 1 dreadnought from your reinforcements in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.
details.flavorText: Elder Junn sighed. "Disarmament, it seems, has fallen out of fashion in these dark days."

details.name: Blitz
details.window: At the start of an invasion
details.text: Each of your non-fighter ships in the active system that do not have BOMBARDMENT gain BOMBARDMENT 6 until the end of the invasion.
details.flavorText: T-these weren't meant to be used like this. T-this is a t-terrible idea. Tai mumbled, wringing his hands. "Well 'course it is," Dart grinned, slamming his fist down on the release lock. "But we've got about sixty kilotons of 'surprise' and nothing to lose!"

details.name: Counterstroke
details.window: After another player activates a system that contains 1 of your command tokens
details.text: Return that command token to your tactic pool.
details.flavorText: That's the thing about loyalty -  Viktor mused, turning one of the pieces backward, facing its own side. "It can be bought."

details.name: Fighter Conscription
details.window: Action
details.text: Place 1 fighter from your reinforcements in each system that contains 1 or more of your space docks or units that have capacity. They cannot be placed in systems that contain other players' ships.
details.flavorText: T'esla grinned as her shimmering vessel lifted off the flight deck - at last, that damned Viscount would experience the superiority of Naalu dogfighting. "Get ready," she hissed into the comms.

details.name: Forward Supply Base
details.window: After another player activates a system that contains your units
details.text: Gain 3 trade goods. Then, choose another player to gain 1 trade good.
details.flavorText: All eyes turned toward the darkening skies as the only surviving supply truck rolled through the gates. "Get these checked in and send the last shipment to our allies!" Harrugh yelled over the din of the engines.

details.name: Ghost Squad
details.window: After another player commits units to land on a planet you control
details.text: Move any number of your ground forces from any planet you control in the active system to any other planet you control in the active system.
details.flavorText: The L1 advance team was expecting to find the outpost abandoned. What they found - unfortunately for them - was Connor.

details.name: Hack Election
details.window: After an agenda is revealed
details.text: During this agenda, you vote last.
details.flavorText: YOUR [NULL ID] STATELY GAME WILL BE FOR NAUGHT<< [VAR:42687] ORDER WILL ARISE FROM [VAR:89001] CHAOS<< IT IS OUR HAND THAT CONTROLS THE OUTCOME

details.name: Harness Energy
details.window: After you activate an anomaly
details.text: Replenish your commodities.
details.flavorText: Manipulating the cosmos was a power reserved for the gods. Rowl spat at the ground as his contraption whirred to life. "Not anymore."

details.name: Impersonation
details.window: Action
details.text: Spend 3 influence to draw 1 secret objective.
details.flavorText: Also, Connor continued, bemused. "Someone just handed me this as I was leaving. I think it was meant for our dear friend Sucaban. We should be able to put it to good use."

details.name: Insider Information
details.window: After an agenda is revealed
details.text: Look at the top 3 cards of the agenda deck.
details.flavorText: M'aban yawned. Another filibuster. Politics could be so flavorless at times. Besides, she already knew how this one was going to turn out. Not well. Not well at all...

details.name: Master Plan
details.window: After you perform an action
details.text: Perform an additional action.
details.flavorText: Viktor laced his long fingers with a wicked smile. Unlenn would be proud. The tactician's reputation was well-earned; even pawns could unseat kings.

details.name: Plagiarize
details.window: Action
details.text: Spend 5 influence and choose a non-faction technology owned by 1 of your neighbors. Gain that technology.
details.flavorText: The Yssaril spies handed over their prize to Connor, who in turn passed it to the Sol engineers with a grim smile. "Now then, boys," he said, one hand on his rifle, "about those loose ends..."

details.name: Rally
details.window: After you activate a system that contains another player's ships
details.text: Place 2 command tokens from your reinforcements in your fleet pool.
details.flavorText: The Federation advance would not be halted - not today. Claire set her broadcast to play on all open channels. She began, her voice fierce and unwavering "Friends! On this day, our names shall be inscribed in the pages of legend!"

details.name: Reflective Shielding
details.window: When one of your ships uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE during combat
details.text: Produce 2 hits against your opponent's ships in the active system.
details.flavorText: Prit scrambled up Hesh's shoulder, gleefully clapping as the entropic shielding tore the mercenary cruisers apart.

details.name: Sanction
details.window: After an agenda is revealed
details.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, each player that voted for that outcome returns 1 command token from their fleet supply to their reinforcements.
details.flavorText: Two can play at this game.

details.name: Scramble Frequency
details.window: After another player makes a BOMBARDMENT, SPACE CANNON, or ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE roll
details.text: That player rerolls all of their dice.
details.flavorText: I will not accept this from that worthless scum! Feng growled as his enigmatic companion interfaced with the ship's nav suite. The Memoria's position flickered and shifted, and the blast flashed harmlessly by.

details.name: Solar Flare
details.window: After you activate a system
details.text: During the "Movement" step of this tactical action, other players cannot use SPACE CANNON against your ships.
details.flavorText: Meian braced for combat as the fleet entered the Ordinian system, but there were no Valefar droneships waiting to meet them. The solar flare gambit had succeeded - they were completely undetected.

details.name: War Machine
details.window: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION
details.text: Apply +4 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.
details.flavorText: This would take weeks to replace if you had run it backwards, Varish called as she rotated the massive capacitor bank. "Okay, fire it up."
details.wildWildWindow: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION
details.wildWildText: Apply +4 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 5.

details.name: War Machine
details.window: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION
details.text: Apply +4 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.
details.flavorText: The station vibrated as the device sputtered to life, emitting a high-pitched buzz to Varish's ears. "Micro-wormholes are cycling at 19 kilohertz," Cole read. "The entropic field tap's stable."
details.wildWildWindow: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION
details.wildWildText: Apply +4 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 5.

details.name: War Machine
details.window: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION
details.text: Apply +4 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.
details.flavorText: The station's production facilities spooled up to new intensities, lights flaring as the assembly line drones increased their speeds to keep up.
details.wildWildWindow: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION
details.wildWildText: Apply +4 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 5.

details.name: War Machine
details.window: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION
details.text: Apply +4 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.
details.flavorText: Varish, let the Commanders know they can contact the Tetrarchy. Tell them the fighter squadron assembly will be done ahead of schedule, and under budget.
details.wildWildWindow: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION
details.wildWildText: Apply +4 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 5.

details.name: Archaeological Expedition
details.window: Action
details.text: Reveal the top 3 cards of an exploration deck that matches a planet you control; gain any relic fragments that you reveal and discard the rest.
details.flavorText: Hiari pressed the activation glyphs, and the ancient door hissed open. As she stepped into the pitch-black interior of the Mahact tomb, she felt a shiver of anticipation. Perhaps, finally, she would find the Codex.

details.name: Confounding Legal Text
details.window: When another player is elected as the outcome of an agenda
details.text: You are the elected player instead.
details.flavorText: Unfortunately, Cinnabian said in a level voice, "the Galactic Council requires the dispute be arbitrated by a truly neutral party. As the Titans were still slumbering when your war began, we will oversee your negotiations... instead of your friends on Jord."

details.name: Coup d'Etat
details.window: When another player would perform a strategic action
details.text: End that player's turn, the strategic action is not resolved and the strategy card is not exhausted.
details.flavorText: Artuno shoved the slug pistol into Huro's face as armored mercenaries stormed into the office. "I'm afraid the station's undergoing a change in management."

details.name: Deadly Plot
details.window: During the agenda phase when an outcome would be resolved
details.text: If you voted for or predicted another outcome, discard the agenda instead. The agenda is resolved with no effect and it is not replaced. Then, exhaust all of your planets.
details.flavorText: The hooded envoy erupted into a nightmare of black metal, lunging at the shocked diplomats.

details.name: Decoy Operation
details.window: After another player activates a system that contains 1 or more of your structures
details.text: Remove up to 2 of your ground forces from the game board and place them on a planet you control in the active system.
details.flavorText: Enemy fire lashed the abandoned positions on the ridgeline as Trilossa's flock slipped unseen around their flanks.

details.name: Diplomatic Pressure
details.window: When an agenda is revealed
details.text: Choose another player. That player must give you 1 promissory note from their hand.
details.notes: One player cannot play multiple of these targeting the same player during the same agenda.
details.flavorText: The Arborec emissary leaned close, and Brother Milor flinched at the faint whiff of decay. "You do not understand," Dirzuga Ohao rasped. "You must support this measure."
details.wildWildWindow: When an agenda is revealed
details.wildWildText: Choose another player. That player must give you 3 promissory notes from their hand.

details.name: Diplomatic Pressure
details.window: When an agenda is revealed
details.text: Choose another player. That player must give you 1 promissory note from their hand.
details.notes: One player cannot play multiple of these targeting the same player during the same agenda.
details.flavorText: Brother Milor shook his head. "The Brotherhood cannot support your war against this extra-dimensional threat." Dirzuga Ohao raised an eyebrow. "Are you certain?"
details.wildWildWindow: When an agenda is revealed
details.wildWildText: Choose another player. That player must give you 3 promissory notes from their hand.

details.name: Diplomatic Pressure
details.window: When an agenda is revealed
details.text: Choose another player. That player must give you 1 promissory note from their hand.
details.notes: One player cannot play multiple of these targeting the same player during the same agenda.
details.flavorText: It would be unfortunate, the Arborec Dirzuga said, "if your supplies of diraxium were to dry up. How would your fleet defend you if we stopped supplying its fuel?"
details.wildWildWindow: When an agenda is revealed
details.wildWildText: Choose another player. That player must give you 3 promissory notes from their hand.

details.name: Diplomatic Pressure
details.window: When an agenda is revealed
details.text: Choose another player. That player must give you 1 promissory note from their hand.
details.notes: One player cannot play multiple of these targeting the same player during the same agenda.
details.flavorText: Damn you! Brother Milor hissed. "You leave us no choice but to fight in your war." Dirzuga Ohao smiled, dead skin stretching over her teeth.
details.wildWildWindow: When an agenda is revealed
details.wildWildText: Choose another player. That player must give you 3 promissory notes from their hand.

details.name: Divert Funding
details.window: Action
details.text: Return a non-unit upgrade, non-faction technology that you own to your technology deck. Then, research another technology.
details.flavorText: I am sorry, Academician, Arbiter Berekon shrugged. "I am sure psychoarchaeology is an interesting subject, but the supreme leader feels your budget would be better spent on more militaristic research."

details.name: Exploration Probe
details.window: Action
details.text: Explore a frontier token that is in or adjacent to a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.
details.flavorText: With a dull thud, the probe shot from the cruiser and accelerated into the writhing maelstrom of the gravity rift. Admiral DeLouis paced on the bridge. Hopefully, this time the probe would return.

details.name: Manipulate Investments
details.window: At the start of the strategy phase
details.text: Place a total of 5 trade goods from the supply on strategy cards of your choice. You must place these tokens on at least 3 different cards.
details.flavorText: But my good fellow, the envoy sputtered. "Surely you can't expect me to agree to those prices!" Durruq leaned in close. "Check again. You may find your goods are trading for less than you think."

details.name: Nav Suite
details.window: After you activate a system
details.text: During the 'Movement' step of this tactical action, ignore the effect of anomalies.
details.flavorText: The field is too thick! Sikosk gasped. Trrakan's plume flared. "Not for me, and not for Iruth." A flick of his talon, and the destroyer flipped and dove for the asteroid field.

details.name: Refit Troops
details.window: Action
details.text: Choose 1 or 2 of your infantry on the game board. Replace each of those infantry with mechs.
details.flavorText: Sek'kus leapt from the trenches, the plasma projectors on her Valkyrie exoskeleton howling as they scoured the field ahead of her.

details.name: Reveal Prototype
details.window: At the start of a combat
details.text: Spend 4 resources to research a unit upgrade technology of the same type as 1 of your units that is participating in this combat.
details.notes: You must still meet the prerequisites of the unit upgrade you wish to research, unless you are Nekro, who will get command tokens instead as usual.
details.flavorText: Varish and Cole completed the final linkages, activating the field harvester. The cruiser's beams roared with renewed power, cutting through the enemy ship.

details.name: Reverse Engineer
details.window: After another player discards an action card that has a component action
details.text: Take that action card from the discard pile.
details.flavorText: Xuange spread their hands over the captured harvester. Mirroring their careful gestures, dark energy fields unfolded and began delicately disassembling the device.

details.name: Rout
details.window: At the start of the 'Announce Retreats' step of space combat, if you are the defender
details.text: Your opponent must announce a retreat, if able.
details.flavorText: Vuil'raith fleshships swarmed the weary defenders, sending unease and sweeping through the telepathic links. But Z'eu projected a powerful feeling of calm, and the Naalu fighters began to drive the Cabal back toward the rift.

details.name: Scuttle
details.window: Action
details.text: Choose 1 or 2 of your non-fighter ships on the game board and return them to your reinforcements. Gain trade goods equal to the combined cost of those ships.
details.flavorText: Rear Admiral Farran saluted as he watched the blasted starship being towed to the scrap yard. "You served me well," he whispered. "Now you can serve the Barony once more."

details.name: Seize Artifact
details.window: Action
details.text: Choose 1 of your neighbors that has 1 or more relic fragments. That player must give you 1 relic fragment of your choice.
details.notes: Note the neighbours requirement.
details.flavorText: Armored dropships crashed into the main dock. Hatches blew open, and Captain Mentarion and her commando raider charged into the facility's heart.

details.name: Waylay
details.window: Before you roll dice for ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE
details.text: Hits from this roll are produced against all ships (not just fighters).
details.flavorText: The destroyers sprayed fire with their secondary batteries as they advanced. The Mahact dreadnought began to list, fire and atmosphere gushing from a thousand tiny wounds.

details.name: Lie in Wait
details.window: After 2 of your neighbors resolve a transaction
details.text: Look at each of those players' hands of action cards, then choose and take 1 action card from each.
details.flavorText: Suffi sauntered toward the huddle of paralyzed Hylar, whistling and twirling her pistols as she walked. "I'll be taking these," she said, flashing a grin, and snatched the humming data drives from each of them in turn.

details.name: Exchange Program
details.window: Action
details.text: Choose another player. You and that player may agree to place 1 infantry from each of your reinforcements into coexistence on a planet the other player controls that contains their ground forces; if no agreement is reached, you each discard 1 token from your fleet pool.
details.notes: This card targets two planets, one owned by each player, which the other player will place a unit on.
details.flavorText: Madness. Magmus thought to himself. A city. Under water. Absurd.

details.name: Puppets on a String
details.window: At the end of a player's turn, if you have passed
details.text: Perform 1 action.
details.flavorText: A red light flashed as the pile that was once thought to be destroyed remains of UNIT_DSGN_ASTAROTH came once more to life. "YOU THOUGHT. YOU BELIEVED YOUR VICTORY SECURE. BUT YOU WERE WRONG."

details.name: Extreme Duress
details.window: At the start of another player's turn, if they have a readied strategy card
details.text: If that player's next action is not a strategic action, they discard all of their action cards, give you all of their trade goods, and show you all of their secret objectives.
details.flavorText: Kan Kip Rel tugged nervously at his collar, fingering the explosive device he knew was there.
details.notes: If combined with Coup d'Etat, the player will face the same decision on their next available action.

details.name: Mercenary Contract
details.window: Action
details.text: Spend 2 trade goods to place 2 neutral infantry on any non-home planet that contains no units; if that planet was owned by another player, they return its planet card to the planet card deck.
details.notes: This cannot be used to target your own planets or the DMZ.
details.flavorText: "Just sign right 'ere - yep, right below the smeared blood. You got it, champ, get at 'em."

details.name: Strategize
details.window: Action
details.text: Perform the secondary ability of any readied or unchosen strategy card.
details.notes: When resolving the chosen secondary ability, you must still spend the strategy token, except for Leadership. You must declare which strategy card you are choosing before the Sabo window, but need not declare how you will resolve the secondary ability.
details.flavorText: Kyver stared Mathis in the eye, unblinking. For a time, neither made a move. The greens and browns of Kyver's eyes were impassive. They betrayed nothing of his intent. Nothing of his past or his future. They were but windows to the wild, unforgiving jungles of Retillion.

details.name: Strategize
details.window: Action
details.text: Perform the secondary ability of any readied or unchosen strategy card.
details.notes: When resolving the chosen secondary ability, you must still spend the strategy token, except for Leadership. You must declare which strategy card you are choosing before the Sabo window, but need not declare how you will resolve the secondary ability.
details.flavorText: Sweat dripped down Mathis' brow. To show weakness now would mean defeat. Death would be preferable to that. But then, as if the divine providence of the Lazax were within her, she saw something she had overlooked. An opening! Her hand darted forward as she made her play. She smirked.

details.name: Strategize
details.window: Action
details.text: Perform the secondary ability of any readied or unchosen strategy card.
details.notes: When resolving the chosen secondary ability, you must still spend the strategy token, except for Leadership. You must declare which strategy card you are choosing before the Sabo window, but need not declare how you will resolve the secondary ability.
details.flavorText: Strategy. What meaning could be derived from the word, what flesh could be sucked clean off its bones? There was a spark, almost like remembering, but it faded. Violently.

details.name: Strategize
details.window: Action
details.text: Perform the secondary ability of any readied or unchosen strategy card.
details.notes: When resolving the chosen secondary ability, you must still spend the strategy token, except for Leadership. You must declare which strategy card you are choosing before the Sabo window, but need not declare how you will resolve the secondary ability.
details.flavorText: No, there would be no strategy here, only hunger. Life, blood, love, life, fear, fear, fear. Let the ants mill about with their strategies. No strategy would avail them today.

details.name: Rescue
details.window: After a player moves ships into a system that contains your ships
details.text: You may move 1 of your ships into the active system from any system that does not contain one of your command tokens.
details.notes: If the target ship has a capacity value, it may transport fighters and ground forces.
details.flavorText: "Hold on..." Tuck pleaded. "We are coming. Hold on, please..."

details.name: Pirate Fleet
details.window: Action
details.text: Spend 3 resources to place 1 neutral carrier, 1 neutral cruiser, 1 neutral destroyer, and 2 neutral fighters in a non-home system that contains no non-neutral ships.
details.flavorText: Felix rubbed his temples as the pirates - well, the other pirates - blipped one by one on the ship's scanner. It was going to be a very long day.

details.name: Brilliance
details.window: Action
details.text: Ready 1 of your planets that has a technology specialty or choose 1 player to gain their breakthrough.
details.flavorText: Crocoan gently stroked the bloodied feathers of screeching cir-le-sh. Such a beautiful song. At last, he'd cracked the code. Soon, Goranthis would be filled with a chorus of such soulful music.

details.name: Black Market Dealings
details.window: When you are negotiating a transaction
details.text: You and the other player may include relics, action cards, and unscored secret objectives as part of the transaction. This card cannot be canceled.
details.flavorText: A chill went up Riad's spine as the Empyrean extended a clawed hand, a small black box floating in their palm, sucking up all the light and life in the room.

details.name: Pirate Contract
details.window: Action
details.text: Place 1 neutral destroyer in a non-home system that contains no non-neutral ships.
details.flavorText: Suffi accepted the contract, swearing her solemn vow that she would see the viceroy's daughter kidnapped and held for ransom by the day's end.

details.name: Pirate Contract
details.window: Action
details.text: Place 1 neutral destroyer in a non-home system that contains no non-neutral ships.
details.flavorText: Suffi accepted the contract, swearing her solemn vow as one of Mogar's Raiders that she would be loyal to the crew above all else.

details.name: Pirate Contract
details.window: Action
details.text: Place 1 neutral destroyer in a non-home system that contains no non-neutral ships.
details.flavorText: Suffi accepted the contract, swearing her solemn vow as a member of the Shadowscald that the job would be completed, one way or another.

details.name: Pirate Contract
details.window: Action
details.text: Place 1 neutral destroyer in a non-home system that contains no non-neutral ships.
details.flavorText: Satisfied, Suffi cashed in her contracts, wondering how long it would take any of them to notice she was gone. After it was much too late, with any luck.

details.name: Crash Landing
details.window: When your last ship in the active system is destroyed
details.text: Place 1 of your ground forces from the space area of the active system onto a planet in that system other than Mecatol Rex; if the planet contains other players' units, place your ground force into coexistence.
details.flavorText: The Long Fall spiraled toward the surface of the rocky planet. Living up to its name, Connor thought dryly.

details.name: Crisis
details.window: At the end of any players turn, if there are at least 2 players who have not passed
details.text: Skip the next player's turn.
details.notes: Pre-set this if possible. If not, please document in your `#cards-info` thread your intention of maybe using it. This will help resolve potential disputes regarding angle-shooting.
details.flavorText: 4X41A "Apollo" shrieked in the skies over Ordinian. Blazing shards of metal and fire rained down upon the planet's surface - the remains of Nekro whose atoms were undergoing a rapid and violent disintegration.

details.name: Overrule
details.window: Action
details.text: Perform the primary ability of a readied or unchosen strategy card.
details.notes: You must declare which strategy card you are choosing before the Sabo window, but need not declare how you will resolve the primary ability. If you choose Trade, you cannot choose other players to resolve the secondary ability.
details.flavorText: Treilla absentmindedly smiled a sickly sweet smile at the newly promoted commander. With any luck, he'd be dead or demoted within a day or two.

details.name: Dynamis Core
details.text:
While this card is in your play area, your commodity value is increased by 2.
ACTION: Gain trade goods equal to your commodity value, then purge this card.
details.flavourText: *Dart and Tai stood, mesmerized by the swirling mass. Neither had any idea what it was, but both were fairly sure they were about to retire.*

details.name: JR-XS455-O
details.text: ACTION: Exhaust this agent and choose a player, that player may spend 3 resources to place a structure on a planet they control. If they do not, they gain 1 trade good.

details.name: Nano-Forge
details.text: ACTION: Attach this card to a non-legendary, non-home planet you control, its resource and influence values are increased by 2 and it is a legendary planet. This action cannot be performed once attached.
details.flavourText: *Intended to bring prosperity, the forge was twisted into an instrument of war.*

details.name: Neuraloop
details.text: When a public objective is revealed, you may purge one of your relics to discard that objective and replace it with a random objective from any objective deck; that objective is a public objective, even if it is a secret objective.
details.flavourText: Knowledge. Creation. Control. Have a wonderful day.

details.name: Circlet of the Void
details.text:
Your units do not roll for gravity rifts, and you ignore the effects of all other anomalies on movement.

ACTION: Exhaust this card to explore a frontier token in a system that does not contain any other players' ships.
details.notes: Gravity rifts still grant the +1 to movement. There must be at least one system containing a frontier token to use the component action.
details.flavourText: Xuange touched the silver circlet that sat upon their temple. The pride of the Archive. Knowledge of the stars, passed down from the First, fated for the Last.

details.name: Book of Latvinia
details.text:
When you gain this card, research up to 2 technologies that have no prerequisites.
> ACTION: Purge this card; if you control planets that have all 4 types of technology specialties, gain 1 victory point. Otherwise, gain the speaker token.
details.flavourText: A collector's item of incalculable value, none have been able to unlock its secrets - assuming its contents aren't just the ravings of a madwoman.

details.name: Enigmatic Device
details.text: Place this card faceup in your play area. ACTION: You may spend 6 resources and purge this card to research 1 technology.

details.name: Dominus Orb
details.text: Before you move units during a tactical action, you may purge this card to move and transport units that are in systems that contain 1 of your command tokens.
details.flavourText: *Goldos hoisted the ivory orb at the head of their army. At once, the weariness that filled the bodies and minds of each soldier vanished. They strode forth as if fresh from a week's rest.*

details.name: Maw of Worlds
details.text: At the start of the agenda phase, you may purge this card and exhaust all of your planets to gain any 1 technology.
details.flavourText: *No larger than a carrier, the spherical lattice held a captive singularity at its heart. As they dumped the planet's entire energy grid into its core, the black hole began to spin, the complex logic-circuitry along the lattice slowly coming to life.*

details.name: Scepter of Emelpar
details.text: When you would spend a token from your strategy pool, you may exhaust this card to spend a token from your reinforcements instead.
details.flavourText: *As the hilt began to fuse with the flesh of her hand, she worried that she should set the scepter aside. But the whispered suggestions in her mind were too valuable and insightful to seriously consider such a rash and illogical act.*

details.name: Shard of the Throne
details.text: When you gain this card, gain 1 victory point, when you lose this card, lose 1 victory point. When a player gains control of a legendary planet you control or a planet you control in your home system, that player gains this card.
details.flavourText: *"What power does a broken piece of the Throne of Emperors hold? To me, none. But to everyone else..."*

details.name: Stellar Converter
details.text: ACTION: Choose 1 non-home, non-legendary planet other than Mecatol Rex in a system that is adjacent to 1 or more of your units that have BOMBARDMENT, destroy all units on that planet and purge its attachments and its planet card. Then, place the destroyed planet token on that planet and purge this card.
details.notes: You cannot explode a planet that you control.
details.flavourText: *A power great enough to envelop a star, such that its energies might be concentrated… and scattered.*

details.name: The Codex
details.text: ACTION: Purge this card to take up to 3 action cards of your choice from the action card discard pile.
details.flavourText: *No single tome could contain the collected knowledge of millennia of rulers. Thus, the last Emperor built a massive cruiser, its holds bulging with crystal info-matrices. It roams the outer reaches of the Mecatol system, awaiting a summons that will never come.*

details.name: The Crown of Emphidia
details.text: After you perform a tactical action, you may exhaust this card to explore 1 planet you control. At the end of the status phase, if you control the "Tomb of Emphidia," you may purge this card to gain 1 victory point.
details.flavourText: *The machines of the forgotten throne-world could only be controlled through the data-impulses of the black-barbed crown.*

details.name: The Crown of Thalnos
details.text: During each combat round, this card's owner may reroll any number of their dice, applying +1 to the results, any units that reroll dice but do not produce at least 1 hit are destroyed.
details.flavourText: *A cloud of satellites spewed from the dreadnought's hull, drifting into a halo around the vessel. The battle seemed to pause for one long moment, before the drones' weapons flared, unleashing beams of energy in all directions.*

details.name: The Obsidian
details.text: When you gain this card, draw 1 secret objective. You can have 1 additional scored or unscored secret objective.
details.flavourText: *The inky blackness of the blade evoked feelings of discomfort and nausea in all who saw it. All but Sharsiss. It whispered to him promises of power. Promises of a reckoning that would see the Collective unmade. "Good," he thought. "Let them burn."*

details.name: The Prophet's Tears
details.text: When you research a technology, you may exhaust this card to ignore 1 prerequisite or draw 1 action card.
details.flavourText: *"So you're going to drink a vial of murky liquid we found in a stasis vault on a dead world because you think it's the concentrated genetic essence of an entire species' most brilliant minds...and you think* I'm *being irrational?"*

details.name: Heart of Ixth
details.text: After any die is rolled, you may exhaust this card to add or subtract 1 from its result.
details.flavourText: "It should be impossible." Feng glanced sidelong at his compatriot. The Thundarian merely stared ahead, as if he did not hear. Feng snorted. "One day I mean to know the source of this so-called power of yours."

details.name: Lightrail Ordnance
details.text: Your space docks gain SPACE CANNON 5 (x2). You may use your space dock's SPACE CANNON against ships that are adjacent to their systems.
details.flavourText:
A single sparkle was the only warning the Yin fleet had before a massive hole had been punched through the hull of the Van Hauge.
Then, searing light.

details.name: Metali Void Armaments
details.text: During the "Anti-Fighter Barrage" step of space combat, you may resolve ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE 6 (x3) against your opponent's units.
details.flavourText: The Metali, Empyrean artificers of legend, were said to have created weapons that harnessed the power of space itself.

details.name: Metali Void Shielding
details.text: Each time hits are produced against 1 or more of your non-fighter ships, 1 of those ships may use SUSTAIN DAMAGE as if it had that ability.
details.flavourText: Capable of more than destruction, the Metali also wrapped their ships in nigh-indestructable plating unable to be replicated using today's methods.

details.name: The Quantumcore
details.text: When you gain this card, gain your breakthrough. You have SYNERGY for all technology types.
details.flavourText: The core burned with the heat of a thousand stars, connections forming and reforming a thousand times per second.

details.name: The Silver Flame
details.text:
The Silver Flame may be exchanged as part of a transaction.
> ACTION: Roll 1 die and purge this card; if the result is a 10, gain 1 victory point. Otherwise, purge your home system and all units in it; you cannot score public objectives. Put The Fracture into play if it is not already.
details.notes: If your home system is purged, you may score _Become A Martyr_. Saar can still score public objectives with a purged home system because of NOMADIC.
details.flavourText: Shen're Ix Ianovar. The flame beyond time and space.

details.name: The Triad
details.text: This card can be readied and spent as if it were a planet card. Its resource and influence values are equal to 3 plus the number of different types of relic fragments you own.
details.flavourText: The light that shines without reflects the dark it harbors within.

details.text2: Against: At the start of the next strategy phase, each player chooses and exhausts 1 planet for each technology that they own.

details.text1: For: The speaker rolls 1 die. If the result is 6-10, each player may research 2 technologies. If the result is 1-5, destroy all units in Mecatol Rex's system, and each player with units in systems adjacent to Mecatol Rex's system destroys 3 of their own units in each of those systems.
details.text2: Against: No effect.

details.mapText: When you gain control of a planet, you gain 1 trade good.

details.flavorText: *Far beneath the storm-wracked seas, vast storage tanks drifted in the lightless depths.*

details.flavorText: *The Imperial Survey Corp outpost had been adandoned since the Twilight Wars, but the facilities had been built to last for millennia.*

details.name: Functioning Base

details.flavorText: *The orbital distribution station proved easy to integrate into the fleet's growing logistical operation.*

details.flavorText: *The local defense forces abandoned their fortress as the first troop transports made planetfall, leaving it open to occupation.*

details.name: Functioning Base
details.text: You may gain 1 commodity, or you may spend 1 trade good or 1 commodity to draw 1 action card.
details.flavorText: *"Yes commander, the base appears completely abandoned. No sign of what happened to the garrison."*

details.flavorText: *Edict 281: All indigenous production facilities are placed under control of the occupational authorities until further notice.*

details.flavorText: *"These people's autofactories can turn out a new starfighter in less time than it takes me to order it!"*

details.name: Local Fabricators
details.text: You may gain 1 commodity, or you may spend 1 trade good or 1 commodity to place 1 mech from your reinforcements on this planet.
details.flavorText: *Though sub-standard, the locally produced munitions were enough to turn the tide of the war.*

details.flavorText: *Within months, bulk transports were arriving from the homeworld, reviving the local economy.*

Place this card faceup in your play area.

details.name: Gamma Relay
details.text: Place a gamma wormhole token in this system. Then, purge this card.
details.flavorText: *Old spacers would tell stories of a black gateway in the deep space beyond the outer Oort Cloud.*

details.name: Lost Crew
details.text: Draw 2 action cards.
details.flavorText: *"Mayday, mayday...this is the free trader* Hrothgar*...losing pressure fast...abandoning ship... Mayday..."*

details.name: Lost Crew
details.text: Draw 2 action cards.
details.flavorText: *Only two survivors were found aboard the derelict, and they had a harrowing tale to tell their saviors.*

details.name: Merchant Station
details.text: You may replenish your commodities, or you may convert your commodities to trade goods.
details.flavorText: *The deep space freeports tend to be infamous dens of criminals, but also valuable nodes in the interplanetary trade networks.*

details.name: Merchant Station
details.text: You may replenish your commodities, or you may convert your commodities to trade goods.
details.flavorText: *"Unidentified vessel, this is Freeport Canopus. State your intentions before approaching."*

details.name: Mirage
details.text: Place the Mirage planet token in this system. Gain the Mirage planet card and ready it. Then, purge this card.
details.flavorText: *The star wasn't supposed to have a habitable planet, but one lay directly in the cruiser's path. And a cloud of starfighters was rising from the world's surface to greet it.*
